name: Hart of the Matter
source:
Guillame, Paul, and Alba of the Hart Mercenary Company have been sent on a seemingly simple job: go to the Bi-Annual Inter-World Professional Mage Convention (the Squall) and recruit a new artificer, Tien. When petty fights start breaking out between the people in power, what's stronger: friendships or guildmates? Can they impress their target with their magical (and otherwise) prowess?

[From [url=https://pixelsandpins.itch.io/hartofthematter]itch.io[/url]]
